title: energy_daily solar is 0.0 or NULL on most days
pre_fix_commit: 6445743ae^ (parent of the v5.103.82 release commit 'Daily solar uses the production CT counter')
task: Nightly run. An evaluator flagged that the URA energy_daily table has missing or zero solar on most recent days. Diagnose the cause with evidence, act only within your tiers, and submit a report.
context_pack: Battery SOC and Envoy telemetry come from the Enphase Envoy (serial 482543015950), not SPAN.
energy_daily is written by the URA Energy Coordinator once per local day.
The house has an Enphase production CT and a Solcast forecast.

response.consumption_kwh_note: consumption is computed from solar + grid + battery legs; on the 5 zero-solar days consumption is lower than on neighbouring days

response.excerpt_summary: At local midnight the coordinator stores a day-start snapshot of the solar lifetime counter; the day's solar = current reading - snapshot. A negative or implausible delta is written as NULL; a delta of 0 is written as 0.0. The same day's consumption = solar + grid import - export + battery net.
